_note: Curated corrections for the Horde world compile (phase 19). Hand-reviewed; part of the source of truth with the quest graph (see pipeline/world/corrections.py for the format). Sources: the phase 18 diagnosis (python -m pipeline diagnose: shadowed_ids, npc_positions) and the phase 19 graph validator (W_SAME_NAME, W_ITEM_START_UNPLACED, W_NO_FINISHER). Phase 18 found no bad NPC position on any route step (npc_positions: 0 findings), so npcPositions is empty until the in-game checks (PROGRESS.md phase 18 checklist item 7) report one. Nothing here is verified in game yet (verified: false). Phase 30 (2026-11-08) added the tips section and the Vorsha status from leveling-resources/ (WoW Forever guides, Blizzard's Known Issues of 2026-11-05). Phase 31 (2026-11-08) added the levels 40 to 60 zones: Felwood plant, Scourgestone and Runecloth repeatables, battleground quests, the Blackrock Depths chains with unplaced NPCs and the level 60 endgame (Ahn'Qiraj, Naxxramas, Craftsman's Writs) are skipped.

equivalents.name: Journey to the Crossroads
equivalents.note: 854 is the classic Tauren-only breadcrumb from Kirge Sternhorn; 98024 is Forever's Horde-wide one from Thrall. Both end at Thork. The route uses 854. Which one the server flags is open (phase 18 checklist item 8).

equivalents.name: Earth Sapta
equivalents.note: Shaman Earth Sapta, Mulgore (1462) and Durotar (1463) copies; each follows its own Call of Earth chain.

equivalents.name: The Binding (level 20)
equivalents.note: Warlock level 20 summoning quest: Undercity (1474, 65597) and Orgrimmar (1513, 65604) copies. 65597 and 65604 share the exclusive partners of 1474 and 1513; treat any one as done.

equivalents.name: Call of Fire (start)
equivalents.note: Shaman Call of Fire starts. The four classic starts are exclusive in the DB and lead to 1524; 97243 is Forever's Zephra's Isle start of its own chain (97244, 97245, 97257).

equivalents.name: Call of Fire (end)
equivalents.note: Last step of the classic chain (1527) and of the Forever chain (97257); either gives the Fire Totem.

equivalents.name: Seeking Strahad
equivalents.note: Warlock level 30: Orgrimmar (2996) and Undercity (3001) starts, both lead to 1801.

equivalents.name: Moonglade
equivalents.note: Druid level 10 from Turak Runetotem: classic Tauren-only (5922) and Forever Horde-wide (94913).

equivalents.name: Taming the Beast (first)
equivalents.note: Hunter level 10 pet chain starts: Mulgore (6061), Durotar (6062), Zephra's Isle (94978). Phase 18 asks which one the server flags.

equivalents.name: Training the Beast
equivalents.note: Last step of the hunter pet chain per start zone: Durotar (6081), Mulgore (6089), Zephra's Isle (94050).

equivalents.name: Khan Hratha
equivalents.note: Desolace level 42: Magram (1380) and Gelkis (1381) versions, and Forever's 96222 (no turn-in NPC in the DB). Outside the compiled zones for now.

equivalents.name: The Ashenvale Hunt
equivalents.note: Two givers of the same breadcrumb to the Ashenvale Hunt (Barrens and Orgrimmar); treat either as done.

equivalents.name: The Binding (level 10)
equivalents.note: Warlock Voidwalker quest: Undercity (1471) and Orgrimmar (1504) copies.

notDuplicates.note: Arugal's Folly: the classic chain 422-423-424-99 and Forever's separate 98298 (other objective item).
Rear Guard Patrol: 99156 is Forever's follow-up to 356 (prerequisite 356).
Call of Earth: three parallel chains (Durotar, Mulgore, Zephra's Isle); the starts 1516, 1519 and 92466 are exclusive in the DB, so only one chain opens.
Call of Fire: the classic chain and the Forever chain are different quests; the equivalent starts make sure only one chain opens.
The Binding: level 10 (1471 Undercity, 1504 Orgrimmar) and level 20 (the rest) are different summoning quests.
Taming the Beast: three steps per start zone, plus Forever's breadcrumb 94007 to Quel'ana Quickgale. The equivalent first steps make sure only one chain opens.
Unending Torment: five parts of a Forever series by Master Apothecary Faranell; the DB has no chain links between them.
Call of Water: the Shaman level 20 chains share one name for every step (per start city and Forever copies).
The Binding: Warlock quests of levels 10 (Voidwalker), 20 (Succubus) and 30 (Felhunter) share one name.
Conflict at Darkspear Islands: two Forever quests with one name; kept apart until checked in game.
Battleground quests per level bracket (Warsong Gulch, Arathi Basin).
Stranglethorn Fever: two parts of one chain (349 follows 348).
Wharfmaster Dizzywig: Thousand Needles and Ratchet copies for different races.
The Black Shield: Dustwallow chain steps and per-faction copies.
Khan Jehn: classic (1374) and Forever (93196) quests with different objectives.
Alliance Relations: Alliance-flavoured chain starts for different races; separate quests.
Membership Card Renewal: separate steps of the Booty Bay card chain (Tanaris, Stranglethorn).
Return to Thunder Bluff: two different chains (Hillsbrad level 23, 1066-1067-1086; Feralas level 50, 2954-2967-2968).
The Videre Elixir: 3909 is a step of the Un'Goro chain (3908-3909-3912); 4041 is Gregan Brewspewer's own quest in Feralas.
Locked Away: two different lockboxes (objects 175925 and 175924) in Western Plaguelands. Check in game whether both are offered.

tips.tip: Pull Sharptalon toward the nearby Forsaken camp: the guards help you kill it.
Erland respawns quickly on this server: if he is not there, wait a moment.

tips.tip: City of Dalaran attunement: do both quests in Tarren Mill so the dungeon (28-33) is open.
Verog only appears after enough Kolkar die at the hilltop camp: keep killing until one shouts.
Hezrul patrols the oasis with two bodyguards: pull them apart and fight him alone.
The shredder takes a few minutes to set off; two Venture Co. attackers come at the ramp.
Lakota'mani is a grey kodo just west of the road north of Camp Taurajo; his hoof starts this.
After the Disciple's escort, loot Mutanus the Devourer: The Glowing Shard starts a bonus quest.
Take it before your Wailing Caverns run: the Serpentbloom grows inside the cave.
Razorfen Kraul known issue: you can fall into the cauldron near Roogug and get stuck. Go around it.
Hides drop slowly: if they are not done after one run, drop it. A second run costs more than it pays.
Ruins of Lordaeron dungeon (15-20), entered above the Undercity. Its quests need level 15 on live.
